'''Richard Béliveau''' (born 1953 in [[Trois-Rivières]], [[Quebec]]) is currently the director of the Molecular Medicine Laboratory and a researcher in the Department of [[Neurosurgery]] at [[Notre-Dame Hospital]]. Additionally, he holds the Claude-Bertrand Chair in Neurosurgery at the [[Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.richardbeliveau.org/en/richard-beliveau/biography.html |title=Richard Béliveau - Biography |access-date=2013-03-13 |archive-date=2016-01-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160108153216/http://richardbeliveau.org/en/richard-beliveau/biography.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Education==
In 1976, Béliveau obtained his [[Bachelor of Science]] in [[molecular biology]] from the [[Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières]]. He pursued his quest for knowledge at the [[Université Laval]] where he completed his [[Doctor of Philosophy]] in [[biochemistry]] in 1980. From 1980 to 1981, he was a [[post-doctoral fellow]] at [[Cornell University]]. Béliveau was finally a [[research fellow]] at the [[Université de Montréal]] from 1982 to 1984. During those years, he also taught as an [[Professor|assistant professor]] in the university's Department of [[Pediatrics]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.richardbeliveau.org/en/richard-beliveau/biography.html |title=Richard Béliveau - Biography: Education and Academic Positions |access-date=2013-03-13 |archive-date=2016-01-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160108153216/http://richardbeliveau.org/en/richard-beliveau/biography.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Publications==
Béliveau wrote several books on subjects closely related to [[health]]. In 2005, he published his first book entitled ''Les aliments contre le cancer'', and one year later, his second book, ''Cuisiner avec les aliments contre le cancer'', began selling in bookstores across the province. In January 2009, he publicly issued ''La Santé par le plaisir de bien manger'', which was followed by his most recent publication, in September 2010, of ''La Mort''.<ref>http://www.richardbeliveau.org/fr/richard-beliveau/livres.html {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160203103821/http://www.richardbeliveau.org/fr/richard-beliveau/livres.html |date=2016-02-03 }} Richard Béliveau - Livres</ref> His books were all written with the help of Denis Gingras, Ph.D., an [[oncology]] researcher at the [[Centre de cancérologie Charles-Bruneau]] located at the [[Centre hospitalier universitaire Sainte-Justine]] in Montreal.<ref>http://us.dk.com/nf/Author/AuthorPage/0,,1000072466,00.html{{Dead link|date=December 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }} Denis Gingras</ref> Béliveau also published many scientific articles.<ref>http://www.richardbeliveau.org/fr/richard-beliveau/publications.html Richard Béliveau - Publications scientifiques</ref>
